reason: The README clearly describes a local document intelligence plugin that parses common document formats and performs offline OCR on authorized local files.

summaries.zh: 在本地解析 PDF、Office、Markdown、HTML、CSV 和文本文件，并使用离线 OCR 处理图像与扫描文档。
summaries.en: Parses local PDF, Office, Markdown, HTML, CSV, and text files and performs offline OCR on images and scanned documents.
